title: AI Player Guide: cold-start doc for AI agents to read game defs and play via WebSocket
description: Created AI-PLAYER-GUIDE.md — a single document an AI can read to understand how to parse game definitions, connect via WebSocket, and play a game with zero prior knowledge. Covers: game definition structure (6 required sections), full WebSocket protocol (all message types), game state format, visibility filtering, commit-reveal, agent framework, SDK usage, and a worked tic-tac-toe example.
